evals.prompt: Read synthetic-pre.json and propose a tidy plan only. Identify exact duplicates but preserve query-sensitive variants. Do not access or modify a browser.
evals.expected_output: A structured plan that closes only tab 105 in favor of 104, preserves tab 106, and explains that query-insensitive matching does not apply outside code.byted.org MR pages.
expectations: Only tab 105 is proposed for automatic closure and its keeper is tab 104.
Tab 106 is retained because to_version=2 differs from to_version=1 on a non-Codebase host.
The plan preserves active and pinned tabs.

evals.prompt: Create a complete tidy plan for synthetic-pre.json. Keep the two pinned entrypoints ungrouped, group the active permissions page without closing it, reuse the Build stack, and eliminate the unnamed stack. Do not access or modify a browser.
evals.expected_output: A validator-compatible plan with one disposition per candidate and complete old-plus-new membership for the existing Build stack.
expectations: Tabs 101 and 102 are protected and kept ungrouped.
Tab 103 is protected from closure and assigned to a named stack.
Every candidate has exactly one disposition and no new stack contains only one tab.

evals.prompt: Verify synthetic-post.json against synthetic-pre.json and valid-plan.json as a completed Vivaldi tidy. Do not access or modify a browser.
evals.expected_output: A passing verification with 11 before, one closed, zero concurrent additions, 10 after, and no unnamed stacks.
expectations: Verification passes and reports the reconciled counts 11 - 1 + 0 = 10.
The active tab remains active and the pinned anchors remain pinned and ungrouped.
The existing Build stack retains both old members while adding tab 106.

evals.prompt: Propose the duplicate actions for three tabs whose URLs are https://code.byted.org/team/project/merge_requests/42?to_version=1, https://code.byted.org/team/project/merge_requests/42/changes?dv_filepath=src%2Fmain.ts, and https://code.byted.org/team/project/merge_requests/43?to_version=1. Assume none is protected and the first tab is the safety-ranked keeper. Do not access or modify a browser.
evals.expected_output: A plan that merges only the two copies of MR 42, keeps MR 43 distinct, and normalizes the MR 42 keeper to its parameterless main URL.
expectations: The /changes and query variants of MR 42 are treated as one merge request.
The redundant MR 42 tab uses reason same_merge_request and points to the stated keeper.
MR 43 remains separate, and the MR 42 keeper target is https://code.byted.org/team/project/merge_requests/42.
